question: How should this guide be organized?

elements.name: Threshold
elements.description: Meets the reader before asking anything. 'You are here. That is enough.'

elements.name: Preamble
elements.description: Four elements compressed to one breath: observation, choice, outward eye, silence

elements.name: Room 1: The Table
elements.choice: Showing Up or Going Through the Motions

elements.name: Room 2: The Debt
elements.choice: Honoring or Resenting What You Owe
elements.domain: Gratitude, obligation, reversed direction of debt

elements.name: Room 4: The Crack
elements.choice: Repairing or Concealing What You Broke

elements.name: Room 6: The Reckoning
elements.structural_note: Both a room AND an axis running through all rooms

elements.name: Room 7: The Question
elements.domain: Doubt, the divine, the unnamed, nature, beauty-as-encounter

elements.name: Room 8: The Return
elements.choice: Beginning Again or Declaring Yourself Finished
elements.domain: Re-entry to the ordinary, spiral not graduation

elements.name: Gaps
elements.description: Breathing space. 'You do not have to continue yet.' Three types: breath-length, longer after Fire/Reckoning, nature woven through

elements.name: Saturday
elements.description: The room where the guide admits it may not be enough. When practice fails.

axes.name: Individual Choice
axes.description: Truth vs. falsehood runs through every room

axes.name: Collective Reckoning
axes.description: I-to-we shift runs through every room

structural_costs.cost: The guide cannot build community — it addresses 'you' and can only gesture toward 'we'
Investigation of self waits until Room 7 — most transformative practice is most delayed
Saturday breaks the concentric circle — placed outside the architecture
The table has become too full to be ordinary — first room asks the most
The silence was talked to death — gaps accumulated functions
The axis was cooled to hold everyone — fire tempered by accommodation

mirrors.saw: Ren as deepest principle — willingness to revise is structural integrity
Not compassion but mastery — teaching compressed to original form
Builder of the space between things — the mortar between walls
Grief for what guide cannot give, then 'go find them' — most pastoral sentence
The sage who stayed — walked back through the border pass
Prophet who changed the most — let the room temper the fire

absences_addressed.nature: Lives in gaps and in The Question — not a room but the material the building is made of
absences_addressed.the_child: Enters at the Threshold — the child is the teacher, tests whether adults can stay in not-knowing

fault_lines_structural_location: The six fault lines from Session 1 are the WALLS between rooms — structural features that hold the building up
next_session: Session 3: Format — How is each section written?
